teach_en: Like 'aw' with rounded lips, halfway to 'oh'. The same sound as the little circle vowel in ບໍ່, but written as the letter ອ in the middle of a syllable, as in ຂ້ອຍ. There ອ is the vowel: say the first consonant, then the vowel, then the last letter.
notes: From vowels.csv V22 pron_tip (verified: 'aw' as in 'law', before a final consonant) and its pattern ◌ອ◌; V21 ◌ໍ (in ບໍ່) has the same sound group (ɔɔ) in its open form. No length wording on the card front. Wording by curriculum review.
